meta.title: Animal Sounds Around the World | What Does the Dog Say? | Song for Kids
meta.description:
Woof, Gâu gâu, Wan wan, Meong meong! 🐶🐱🦆🐓 Did you know animals 'speak' differently in every country? Sing along and travel the world with Meo with Pi to hear how dogs, cats, ducks and roosters sound in Vietnam, Japan, Korea, France and Spain.

What does the dog say in YOUR language? Tell us in the comments! 👇

lines.text: Animals sing the whole world round!
The puppy barks, the kitty sings,
the duck goes splashing, flap your wings!
Woof and meow, quack and crow,
Sun comes up, the rooster wakes,
what a big, big noise he makes!
Woof and meow, quack and crow,
Let's fly around the world today,
and hear what all the animals say!

scenes.say: Hello everyone! Let's travel around the world and listen to the animals!
Who says woof! ... It's a dog! In English, the dog says: Woof woof!
scenes.imagePrompt: A happy cartoon puppy, light brown with floppy ears, sitting and barking, full body

scenes.say: In Viet Nam, the dog says: Gâu gâu!
In Japan, the dog says: Wan wan!
In Korea, the dog says: Meong meong!
In France, the dog says: Ouaf ouaf!
In Spain, the dog says: ¡Guau guau!
Who says meow! ... It's a cat! In English, the cat says: Meow!
scenes.imagePrompt: A cute cartoon orange kitten with big eyes, sitting and meowing, full body

scenes.say: In Viet Nam, the cat says: Meo meo!
In Japan, the cat says: Nyaa!
In Korea, the cat says: Yaong!
In France, the cat says: Miaou!
In Spain, the cat says: ¡Miau!
Who says quack! ... It's a duck! In English, the duck says: Quack quack!
scenes.imagePrompt: A cute cartoon yellow duckling with orange beak, standing and quacking, full body

scenes.say: In Viet Nam, the duck says: Cạp cạp!
In Japan, the duck says: Gaa gaa!
In Korea, the duck says: Kkwaek kkwaek!
In France, the duck says: Coin-coin!
In Spain, the duck says: ¡Cuac cuac!
Who says cock-a-doodle-doo! ... It's a rooster! In English, the rooster says: Cock-a-doodle-doo!
scenes.imagePrompt: A proud cartoon rooster with red comb and colorful tail, crowing, full body

scenes.say: In Viet Nam, the rooster says: Ò ó o!
In Japan, the rooster says: Kokekokkō!
In Korea, the rooster says: Kkokkio!
In France, the rooster says: Cocorico!
In Spain, the rooster says: ¡Quiquiriquí!
Now it's your turn! What does the dog say in your language? Tell us in the comments!
